screen.homelink_quarry.help.title: User guide
screen.homelink_quarry.help.content:
# What does the quarry do?
It mines a rectangular area layer by layer, one block at a time, from Start Y down to Stop Y. Every drop goes into its 27-slot output buffer.

# Level and head
The quarry level only sets the largest area: Quarry I 8×8, Quarry II 16×16, Quarry III 32×32. The Mining Head alone sets the speed: Head I 1 block / 10 s, Head II 1 block / 6 s, Head III 1 block / 3 s. Any head works in any quarry. Heads never wear out.

# Set the area
Right-click a block with the Quarry Marker for Corner A, sneak + right-click another block for Corner B, then right-click this quarry with the marker. Start Y is the higher corner. Change Stop Y in the Area view while the quarry is stopped.

# Energy
The quarry runs on HomeLink Energy (HE) only. Connect it with HomeLink Energy cables to solar panels, wind turbines or batteries; HE enters on every face. Every block costs the same HE whatever the head: the head only sets how fast it is used, energy never makes the quarry faster. HE is only used while a block is drilled. Without HE the quarry waits (No power) and resumes by itself.

# Start, pause and stop
Start needs an area, a head and some stored energy. Pause freezes everything exactly where it is; Resume continues. Stop ends the run but keeps area, progress, head, energy and output: Start continues the same job. A new area or Stop Y starts a new job.

# Output
When the buffer is full the quarry waits (Output full) and nothing is thrown on the ground. Take the items in the Output view, with a hopper below, or with a compatible HomeLink input behind the quarry.

# Safety
Bedrock, portals, command and structure blocks and other listed blocks are never mined. Chests are mined with their content, which goes to the buffer. The quarry never loads chunks: if its area is unloaded it waits (Blocked).

info.homelink_quarry.quarry:
Mines a zone layer by layer with a visible drilling head: up to 8×8 (I), 16×16 (II) or 32×32 (III). It runs on HomeLink Energy through any of its six faces; energy sets how long it runs, never how fast.
Mark the zone with a Quarry Marker, install a Mining Head, set the stop level, then Start. Pause resumes exactly where it stopped.
Its 27-slot buffer empties into a compatible input behind it, such as a Storage Deposit. Bedrock, portals and blacklisted blocks are never mined, claims are checked on the owner's behalf, and chunks are never force-loaded.
info.homelink_quarry.mining_head:
Sets the drilling speed of a quarry: 1 block every 10 s (I), 6 s (II) or 3 s (III). It has no durability.
Heads mine like a plain pickaxe, without Fortune or Silk Touch. Any head fits any quarry tier.
info.homelink_quarry.quarry_marker: Marks the quarry zone: right-click a block for corner A, sneak-right-click for corner B, then right-click the quarry to apply. The start level is the higher corner.
